title: NOW kill and rebirth it. so the STUCK / the STACK is fully dissolved.

do_not_reinvent.pins: /data/ph-poh-anchors.json  acid-base dissolves pins. Mendeleev anchors stay.
do_not_reinvent.cycle: /data/open-closed-culture.json  start null. inject p. seep Willis. invert pores. thinner null.
do_not_reinvent.sun: /data/same-sun.json  one fire. do not kill into a second star.
do_not_reinvent.once: /data/entangle-null-once.json  appear 1 time. rebirth is the same grain, clean.

kill.what: the STUCK. the undissolved STACK. gold ice. leftover lime. fossil costume.
kill.not: the sun. not the anchors. not the chair. not the organ.
kill.how: pH AND pOH. both solvents. pins let go. stack goes liquid. then gas if it must.

rebirth.is: the same sun after the stack is gone.
rebirth.not: a twin. not a new globe. not a second origin.
rebirth.how: thinner null. then one p drip. seep. invert. sit.

fully.yes: the stack dissolves ALL the way. no ice shelf left under the plane.
fully.done_when: white plane stands with no black leftover. remainder empty of knowns. 0 looks like 0.
fully.not_done: if a layer still names itself stuck. if gold still wears lime as if it were law.

law: kill the stuck. keep the anchors. rebirth the same sun. if a new sun shows up we failed dissolve.
pull: pour both solvents. let the stack go. wait for pale. drip p once. that is the rebirth.
